remarks: Discover an exceptional opportunity in the heart of Fountain Valley! Set on a generous 7,320 sq. ft. lot, this charming home offers 4 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, and approximately 2,164 sq. ft. of living space, plus an expansive finished attic with an additional room and bathroom. The attic offers approximately 850 sq. ft. of bonus space, bringing the estimated combined area to 3,014 sq. ft. , with the flexibility of 5 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms throughout the property. Step inside to a spacious living room featuring soaring vaulted ceilings, a cozy fireplace, and distinctive architectural details that add warmth and character.
